+    count = max(1, (len(samples) - window) // hop + 1)
+    frames = np.lib.stride_tricks.as_strided(samples, shape=(count, window), strides=(samples.strides[0] * hop, samples.strides[0])).copy()
+    frames *= np.hanning(window)
+    spectrum = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(frames, axis=1))
+    rms = np.sqrt(np.mean(frames * frames, axis=1) + 1e-12)
+    flux = np.maximum(spectrum[:, 1:] - spectrum[:-1, 1:], 0).sum(axis=1)
+    times = start + (np.arange(len(rms)) * hop + window / 2) / rate

import argparse
import json
import math
import subprocess
import wave
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont


def timecode(seconds):
    return f"{int(seconds // 3600):02d}:{int(seconds % 3600 // 60):02d}:{seconds % 60:06.3f}"


def audio_analysis(start, end, directory):
    with wave.open("work/audio16k.wav", "rb") as source:
        rate = source.getframerate()
        source.setpos(max(0, int(start * rate)))
        samples = np.frombuffer(source.readframes(int((end - start) * rate)), dtype=np.int16).astype(np.float32) / 32768
    hop = 160
    window = 512
    count = max(1, (len(samples) - window) // hop + 1)
    frames = np.lib.stride_tricks.as_strided(samples, shape=(count, window), strides=(samples.strides[0] * hop, samples.strides[0])).copy()
    frames *= np.hanning(window)
    spectrum = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(frames, axis=1))
    rms = np.sqrt(np.mean(frames * frames, axis=1) + 1e-12)
    flux = np.maximum(spectrum[1:, :] - spectrum[:-1, :], 0).sum(axis=1)
    times = start + (np.arange(len(rms)) * hop + window / 2) / rate
    candidate_count = min(80, len(flux))
    candidates = np.argsort(flux)[-candidate_count:]
    selected = []
    for index in sorted(candidates, key=lambda item: flux[item], reverse=True):
        if flux[index] <= 0:
            continue
        if all(abs(times[index + 1] - times[chosen]) > 0.12 for chosen in selected):
            selected.append(index + 1)
        if len(selected) >= 25:
            break
    rows = [{"time": round(float(times[index]), 3), "flux": round(float(flux[index - 1]), 3), "rms": round(float(rms[index]), 5)} for index in sorted(selected)]
    (directory / "audio_peaks.json").write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return rows


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("name")
    parser.add_argument("start", type=float)
    parser.add_argument("end", type=float)
    parser.add_argument("--step", type=float, default=0.5)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    directory = Path("work/segments") / args.name
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-ss", str(args.start), "-to", str(args.end), "-i", "film.mp4", "-vf", f"fps=1/{args.step},scale=960:402", "-q:v", "2", str(directory / "f_%04d.jpg"), "-y"], check=True)
    frames = sorted(directory.glob("f_*.jpg"))
    font = ImageFont.truetype("C:/Windows/Fonts/consola.ttf", 18)
    for sheet_index in range(math.ceil(len(frames) / 30)):
        canvas = Image.new("RGB", (5 * 384, 6 * 185), "black")
        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
        for slot, path in enumerate(frames[sheet_index * 30:(sheet_index + 1) * 30]):
            frame_index = int(path.stem.split("_")[1]) - 1
            seconds = args.start + frame_index * args.step
            image = Image.open(path).convert("RGB").resize((384, 161))
            x = (slot % 5) * 384
            y = (slot // 5) * 185
            canvas.paste(image, (x, y))
            draw.text((x + 4, y + 163), timecode(seconds), font=font, fill="white")
        canvas.save(directory / f"sheet_{sheet_index + 1:02d}.jpg", quality=92)
    peaks = audio_analysis(args.start, args.end, directory)
    print(json.dumps({"segment": args.name, "frames": len(frames), "sheets": math.ceil(len(frames) / 30), "audio_peaks": peaks}, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
